Can't tell from here. I claimed something about historical data without evidence.

What would settle it: query the user table for usernames containing dots or capitals, filtered to accounts created before mid-2022. Something like:

```sql
SELECT username FROM users 
WHERE created_at < '2022-06-01' 
AND (username ~ '\.' OR username ~ '[A-Z]')
LIMIT 10;
```

If that returns rows, existing users will fail the regex and you'll lock them out on login or profile updates.
